Methods for an ARFC fit

Source: R/arfc_methods.R
arfc-methods.Rd

Methods for an ARFC fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
coef(object, type = c("basis", "function"), ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
predict(object, newdata, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
fitted(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
residuals(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.arfc'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'arfc'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("coefficient", "regions", "weights", "tuning"),
  shade_null = TRUE,
  null_col = "grey90",
  ...
)

Arguments

object, x

An object of class arfc.

type

For coef(), return basis coefficients or coefficient-function values. For plot(), choose the coefficient curve, regional norms, adaptive weights, or tuning path.

...

Additional graphical arguments where applicable.

newdata

Optional finite predictor matrix on the training grid.

shade_null

Shade finest-level regions with numerically zero fitted regional norm in coefficient plots.

null_col

Color used for zero-region shading.

Value

coef() returns a vector or data frame; predict(), fitted(), and residuals() return numeric vectors; nobs() returns an integer; printing and plotting methods return their object invisibly.
